# NeighbrVille

> NeighbrVille is a local community platform helping people discover neighborhood experiences, meet neighbors, and feel at home. Initial launch: Early 2027 in London & Berlin.

## Site

- Home: https://neighbrville.com/
- Privacy Policy: https://neighbrville.com/privacy
- Contact: hello@neighbrville.com

## About

NeighbrVille connects people with local experiences (pottery, repair cafés, pasta nights, photo walks, and more), hosts, and community partners. Visitors can join a waitlist as a Neighbr or Partner/Host.

## Key pages

- `/` — marketing homepage with waitlist signup
- `/privacy` — privacy notice

## Do not index

- `/admin` — private admin panel
- `/api/*` — application APIs
- `/join/edit/*` — private profile edit links
